name: uini.io Open Graph social card by uini.io
description: A 1200×630 social card split into a white brand panel and a cream product vignette. The left half stacks a squircle logo, a three-line headline with one word flipped to coral orange, a numbered three-step chip row and a black pill CTA; the right half runs a top-to-bottom pipeline of floating UI cards — behaviour trigger, chat interview, dual insights — tied together by dotted connectors with uppercase orange micro-labels. Soft diffuse shadows, generous radii and cropped beige circles keep it friendly, while the two-tone headline and tiny pipeline type carry the hierarchy.
